summary: A user reported BTC drained from a wallet originally generated on a COLDCARD Mk3 purchased in 2021 and later restored onto a Mk4 using the original recovery phrase. The reported theft occurred alongside a larger drain affecting wallets associated with the COLDCARD Mk3 seed generation issue.
prevention: Move funds from wallets using affected Mk3 generated seeds to a newly generated seed / Apply the manufacturer remediation guidance for affected firmware
